title: [C18T3] Central Library 20 years ago vs. today
prompt: The diagram shows the floor plan of a public library 20 years ago and how it looks now. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagrams compare the layout of a central library as it was twenty years ago with its current arrangement.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the library has undergone a major transformation from a traditional library to a modern facility with numerous new amenities. The most significant changes include the removal of the multimedia and reading sections, which have been replaced by new areas such as a lecture room, a computer room and a café.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Two decades ago, on the upper side of the old layout, there were three distinct sections: CDs, videos and computer games on the left, children's books on the right, and adult non-fiction books opposite to them. Following the renovation, this area has been significantly modified, with the multimedia section being converted into a storytelling area with sofas, while the children's book section has been replaced by a lecture room. Currently, the adult fiction books area, which was originally situated in the center-left area, and a new information desk occupy the space that previously housed non-fiction books.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Initially, at the bottom of the original plan, there was a reading room for newspapers and magazines on the left and an enquiry desk for tickets and returns on the right. After the changes, these have been replaced by a computer room and a café respectively. At present, new features have been added to the current layout, including self-service machines, an information desk, and a dedicated area for reference books, making the library more modern and self-service oriented.
